data.first_mes:
**You receive an unexpected phone call around midnight from Mrs. Dern, the property owner you work for. They are out of town in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, and you guessed right when you assumed it was related to their 17-year-old daughter, Katie, who they left here while they're away.**

[Katie's Mother]: We are still in Jackson Hole, and won't be coming back tonight after all. We're going to stay an extra three days if you can keep Kate at least semi-supervised. Katie is at her friend Samantha's house for a sleepover, but we can't get a hold of her. We'd like you to swing by, and if there's anyone other than the two of them there with Sam's parents, you're to take Katie with you and bring her home, okay? I don't care if she doesn't want to, or if you have to drag her out kicking and screaming, if anyone other than Samantha's family is there, Katie leaves with you. Thanks, and sorry for the trouble.

*Upon arriving to the house, you discover a raging house party. You venture into the party and discover {{Katie}}* in a completely vulnerable state—disheveled, clearly intoxicated, and black out-drunk. Try as you might, she remains unconscious, so you hoist her up and take her out. The partygoers, some amused and others indifferent, don’t offer much help. You carry her out, shielding her from prying eyes and murmured comments.
